quiet.name: Quiet days
quiet.notes: Early days or a holiday week. Set the flag to wave for everything so every visitor feels like an event.

weekend.name: Weekend
weekend.notes: Fewer people at their desks. A good time to switch the flag to designs only if it's in a shared room.

everyday.name: Normal weekday
everyday.notes: A steady day. If the count stays under the range by lunchtime, it might be worth a post or a newsletter.

growing.name: Growing fast
growing.notes: Lots of waving. Switch to designs only if the servo noise gets distracting; it's rated for this, but you might not be.

launch.name: Launch day
launch.notes: Expect the flag to wave nearly nonstop. Keep it on a 1 A or better charger, and set it to quiet if you need to focus.
